text:
PAYMENTS OVERSIGHT COUNCIL FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Final rule: Reimbursement for authorized push payment scams
Notice number: RCN-2026-006
Issued by: Payments Oversight Council
Published: 2026-09-15
Effective date: 2027-04-01
1. Who this applies to
Payment service providers that send instant or same-day account-to-account payments for consumers.
2. Background
Victims of scams that trick them into sending money should not bear the loss alone. The Council sets a reimbursement standard and asks firms to warn customers before risky payments.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must reimburse an eligible scam victim within 5 business days of the claim, unless it has evidence of gross negligence or first-party fraud.
3.2 A firm must check the payee name against the account and show the customer a warning when the name does not match before a first payment to a new payee.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-04-01.
